name: v1.2.5
body:
## 📌 v1.2.5 - 2021/10/20

### ✨ Feature

* `qaterial::HotReload::resetCurrentFile()` API to reset the loaded file.
This is useful if you loaded some buggy, and you don't want to delete it from disk
* QaterialHotReloadApp: `--reset-current-file` that Force reset of current file

### 👷 CI

* remove old artifacts once a week

### ⬆️ Dependencies

* Qaterial v1.4.6

name: v1.2.4
body:
🐛 Make sure app doesn't get stuck on loading dialog, when not qml file is selected yet.
💄 Improve splitview style by using Qaterial's ColorTheme

name: v1.2.3
body:
🔨 Optional SortFilterProxyModel for App
🔇 Disable QaterialHotReload CMake log when project is included.
Log can be enabled by user using QATERIALHOTRELOAD_VERBOSE

name: v1.2.2
v1.2.0
body:
💥 Move Main.qml inside Qaterial::HotReload instead of App for easier integration with project that do not need to write their own Main.qml
✨ Allow to resetImportPath from C++. Very useful when qrc import path are dirty after a Qt update or something.
✨ add to app --reset-imports option to clear last qml import paths and reset them
✨ Don't use Qaterial.Logger
✨ Time HotReload clearCache/createComponent/incubateObject
🚑 Make sure that hotreload is valid item when sinking logs
🐛 Fix pch include (QOlm is now Qaterial private dependency)
✨ Add option to disable support of extra qt plugins
  - Charts
 -  DataVisualization
  - VirtualKeyboard
  - WebChannel
  - WebSockets
  - 3DCore
  - 3DRender
  - 3DInput
  - 3DLogic
  - 3DExtras
  - 3DAnimation
  - Quick3D
  - Quick3DAssetImport
  - Quick3DRender
  - Quick3DRuntimeRender
  - Quick3DUtils
🔨 Default enable QATERIALHOTRELOAD_ENABLE_HOTRELOAD_APP when we are main project
📌 Pin Qaterial/QOlm dependencies to current working master (v1.4.0)
👷 Macos: Use legacy build system in CI
♻️ Fix QLINUXCMAKE_* to QTLINUXCMAKE_*
